environment.captureDriver: external to this repository, using the Playwright already installed in the OpenFox checkout
environment.groundTruthRule: Every label is read from the OpenFox HTTP API at the moment of the screenshot (GET /api/sessions phase and isRunning, GET /api/providers reachability, route path). No label is derived from pixels or from a filename.

blocker.summary: No usable LLM provider is reachable in this environment, so three of the seven contract states cannot be produced honestly.
blocker.detail: The only active provider in the OpenFox dev instance is 'Local' -> http://localhost:1234/v1 (LM Studio). That port refuses connections. The Ollama server on 11434 answers /v1/models but exposes zero models. Because the agent never receives a completion, the session stays in phase 'plan' with isRunning true and the UI renders the provider-failure retry banner. Consequently: (a) 'processing' cannot be distinguished from 'explicit error' because the same frame renders in both; (b) 'blocked' and 'waiting' require a workflow execution that must first complete an LLM step, and three launches of the built-in 'Build & Verify' workflow never left phase 'plan'; (c) 'authentication required' requires enabling the network auth strategy in the OpenFox config, which is an environment change deliberately not made to manufacture a fixture.
notDoneToAvoidFabrication: enabling the OpenFox network auth strategy to synthesize a login screen
editing the provider configuration to point at a model
duplicating or re-cropping a single frame to inflate a state count

acquisition.sha256Values: full 64-character digests, recomputed from the committed files
